When using non-manual triggers, you can control the delay to open and close the popover through the openDelay and closeDelay properties. Note that the autoClose feature does not use the close delay, it closes the popover immediately.

When using the hover trigger with a closeDelay, the popover will remain open if the mouse enters it before the close delay is over. This is important for accessibility as it allows users of screen magnifiers to move the cursor over the popover so they can magnify and read it without it disappearing. (See WCAG Success Criterion 1.4.13.)
